You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker = minority color forming diagonal segment; obstacle = other big block color
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # identify obstacle color: color with count != small diagonal
    obst=max(colors,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in colors if c!=obst][0]
    seg=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark]
    dirs={(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)}
    # determine ray direction from segment order
    (a,b)=min(seg),max(seg)
    d=(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])
    d=(d[0]>0-(d[0]<0),d[1]>0-(d[1]<0))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def step(p,d):
        np_=p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1]
        if not(0<=np_<H and 0<=np_<W): return None,'edge'
        v=inp[np_]
        if v==obst: return None,'obs'
        return np_,v
    for start,d0 in [(min(seg),(-d[0],-d[1])),(max(seg),d0)]:
        p=start; dd=d0
        while True:
            n,cause=step(p,dd)
            if cause=='edge': break
            if cause=='obs':
                dd=(-dd[0],-dd[1]) if 'vert' in str(dd) else (dd[0],-dd[1])
                # choose reflection: reflect component pointing into obstacle
                pp=p[0]+dd[0],p[1]+dd[1]
                if 0<=pp[0]<H and 0<=pp[1]<W and inp[pp[0]][pp[1]]!=obst:
                    dd=(-dd[0],dd[1])
                else:
                    break
            p=n
            if inp[p[0]][p[1]]==mark: break
            out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    return out
# verify demos

    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

print('test diff:',diff)

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obst=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in others if c!=obst][0]
    seg=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark)
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def mark3(p):
        if inp[p[0]][p[1]]==bg: out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    for s,e in ((seg[0],seg[-1]),(seg[-1],seg[0])):
        dd=(e[0]-s[0], e[1]-s[1]); dd=(dd[0]>0-(dd[0]<0), dd[1]>0-(dd[1]<0))
        d=dd if s==seg[-1] else (-dd[0],-dd[1])
        # outward direction from the chosen endpoint
        p=s
        while True:
            q=(p[0]+d[0], p[1]+d[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W): break
            v=inp[q[0]][q[1]]
            if v==mark: break
            if v==obst:
                horiz_wall = (q[0]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]-1][q[1]]==obst) or (q[0]+1<H and inp[q[0]+1][q[1]]==obst)
                vert_wall = (q[1]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]][q[1]-1]==obst) or (q[1]+1<W and inp[q[0]][q[1]+1]==obst)
                if horiz_wall: d=(-d[0],d[1])
                elif vert_wall: d=(d[0],-d[1])
                else:
                    nd=[nd for nd in [(-d[0],d[1]),(d[0],-d[1])]
                       if 0<=p[0]+nd[0]<H and 0<=p[1]+nd[1]<W and inp[p[0]+nd[0]][p[1]+nd[1]]!=obst]
                    d=nd[0] if nd else None; continue
                continue
            p=q; mark3(p)
    return out

def f(inp, keep=True):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obst=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in others if c!=obst][0]
    seg=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark)
    s,e=seg[0],seg[-1]
    o=(e[0]-s[0],e[1]-s[1]); o=(o[0]>0,(o[1]>0))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def set3(p):
        if out[p[0]][p[1]]==bg: out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    # forward from the far end
    p=e; d=o
    while True:
        q=(p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1])
        if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W): break
        v=inp[q[0]][q[1]]
        if v==mark: break
        if v==obst:
            horiz = (q[0]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]-1][q[1]]==obst) or (q[0]+1<H and inp[q[0]+1][q[1]]==obst)
            vert   = (q[1]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]][q[1]-1]==obst) or (q[1]+1<W and inp[q[0]][q[1]+1]==obst)
            if horiz: d=(-d[0],d[1]); continue
            if vert:  d=(d[0],-d[1]); continue
            # corner ambiguity: choose flip keeping both components valid-ish
            cands=[]
            for nd in [(-d[0],d[1]),(d[0],-d[1])]:
                np2=(p[0]+nd[0],p[1]+nd[1])
                if 0<=np2[0]<H and 0<=np2[1]<W and inp[np2[0]][np2[1]]!=obst: cands.append(nd)
            d=cands[0] if cands else None
            continue
        p=q; set3(p)
    return out

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def get(h,w,k):
    m=re.search(re.escape(k)+r' \(\d+x\d+\):\n', t)
    i=m.start()
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[i:].split('\n')[:h]]
    return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
G={'D2i':get(30,30,'Demo pair 2 input'),'D2o':get(30,30,'Demo pair 2 output'),
   'D3i':get(15,27,'Demo pair 3 input'),'D3o':get(15,27,'Demo pair 3 output'),'T':get(13,23,'Test input')}
for k,v in G.items():
    cnt={}
    for r in v:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda y:cnt[y])
    pts=[(i,j,v[i][j]) for i in range(len(v)) for j in range(len(v[0])) if v[i][j]!=bg]
    print(k,cnt,'bg',bg,pts)

def sim(g, seg_col, bg, seg_cells):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=set(seg_cells)
    # direction: sort; d = (r diff, c diff) normalized
    pts=sorted(seg_cells); 
    dr=pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]
    import math
    gdr,gdc=dr//math.gcd(dr,dc),dc//math.gcd(dc,dc)
    cur=pts[-1]; res=[]
    def free(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in cs
    for _ in range(H*W):
        nr,nc=cur[0]+gdr,cur[1]+gdc
        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in cs:
            cur=(nr,nc); res.append((cur[0],cur[1]))
            if len(res)>H*W: break
        elif 0<=nc<W and g[cur[0]][nc]==bg and not (cur[0],nc) in cs:
            # vertical wall -> flip dc
            cur=(cur[0],nc-gdc+gdc) if False else None
            break
        else:
            break
    return res

import os,re,collections
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
g=G['Demo pair 4 input']; o=G['Demo pair 4 output']
H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
# visualize changed cells per demo
diff=[(i,j,g[i][j],o[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=o[i][j]]
print(diff)

def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j] not in (9,) and inp[i][j]!=3]
    # find the diagonal seed color: a color appearing on a down-right diagonal chain length>=2
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(inp[i][j] for r in inp for j in r)
    seeds=[c for c in cnt if c!=9 and cnt[c]>=2]
    col=seeds[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==col]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # direction = consecutive step
    (r,c),(r2,c2)=cells[-1],cells[-2]
    dr=r2-r; dc=c2-c
    cur_r,cur_c=cells[-1]; painted=[]
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur_r+dr,cur_c+dc
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or inp[nr][nc]!=9:
            break
        out[nr][nc]=3; painted.append((nr,nc)); cur_r,cur_c=nr,nc
    # reflect: try all component-flips and both-flip, pick longest run into free cells
    best=None
    for nd in [(-dr,-dc),(-dr,dc),(dr,-dc)]:
        cur_r,cur_c=cur_r,cur_c
        while True:
            nr,nc=cur_r+nd[0],cur_c+nd[1]
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or inp[nr][nc]!=9: break
            out[nr][nc]=3; painted.append((nr,nc)); cur_r,cur_c=nr,nc
            if len(painted)>len(best) and best is not None: best=(nd,len(painted))
    return out,painted,best

import os,glob,re,json
def load(f):
    txt=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in txt[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import math
def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=None; bandcells=set()
    for c in cnt:
        if c==bg: continue
        fr=[r for r in range(h) if all(gi[r][j]==c for j in range(w))]
        fc=[j for j in range(w) if all(gi[r][j]==c for r in range(h))]
        if fr: band=c; bandcells={(r,j) for r in fr for j in range(w)}
        if fc: band=c; bandcells={(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in fc}
        break
    strs=sorted((r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[r][j] not in (bg,band))
    # segment direction from consecutive strays
    dr=strs[1][0]-strs[0][0]; dc=strs[1][1]-strs[0][1]
    g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); d=(dr//g,dc//g)
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    def free(r,c): return 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and gi[r][c] not in bandcells
    seen=set(strs)
    for start in (strs[0], strs[-1]):
        sdr,sdc=start[0]+d[0],start[1]+d[1]
        while True:
            rr,cc=sdr,sdc
            if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w): break
            if (rr,cc) in bandcells:
                # reflect
                nrd,nrd2=( -sdr if free(rr-1,cc) else sdr, -sdc if free(rr,cc-1) else sdc)
                # determine which axis hit
                ahead_r = free(rr+sdr, cc) if 0<=rr+sdr<h and 0<=cc<w else False
                ahead_c = free(rr, cc+sdc) if 0<=rr<w and 0<=cc+sdc<w else False
                if ahead_r and not ahead_c: sdr=-sdr
                elif ahead_c and not ahead_r: sdc=-sdc
                else: break
                rr+=sdr; cc+=sdc
                continue
            if gi[rr][cc] not in (bg,band): break  # hits another object -> stop? 
            out[rr][cc]=3
            sdr,sdc=1,1
            rr+=sdr; cc+=sdc
    return out
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    pred=solve(gi)
    print(n, 'match' if pred==go else 'MISMATCH')
    if pred!=go:
        for r in range(len(gi)):
            if pred[r]!=go[r]: print(' row',r,'pred',''.join(map(str,pred[r])),'exp',''.join(map(str,go[r])))

import math
def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=None; bandcells=set()
    for c in cnt:
        if c==bg: continue
        fr=[r for r in range(h) if all(gi[r][j]==c for j in range(w))]
        fc=[j for j in range(w) if all(gi[r][j]==c for r in range(h))]
        if fr: band=c; bandcells={(r,j) for r in fr for j in range(w)}
        elif fc: band=c; bandcells={(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in fc}
        else: continue
        break
    strs=sorted((r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if gi[r][j] not in (bg,band))
    dr=strs[1][0]-strs[0][0]; dc=strs[1][1]-strs[0][1]
    g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); d=(dr//g,dc//g)
    def free(r,c): return 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and gi[r][c] not in bandcells and gi[r][c]!=3
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    def extend(start,sdir):
        r,c=start[0]+sdir[0],start[1]+sdir[1]; k=0
        while True:
            k+=1
            rr,cc=r+sdir[0]*k,c+sdir[1]*k
            if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w): return
            if (rr,cc) in bandcells or gi[rr][cc] not in (bg,): 
                # reflect: try flipping components
                moved=False
                for nd in [(-sdir[0],sdir[1]),(sdir[0],-sdir[1]),(-sdir[0],-sdir[1])]:
                    nr,nc=rr+nd[0],cc+nd[1]
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and gi[nr][nc] in (bg,) and not ((nr,nc) in bandcells or nd==(0,0)):
                        sdir=nd; break
                else: return
                rr=r+sdir[0]*(k-1); cc=c+sdir[1]*(k-1)
                continue
            out[rr][cc]=3; r,c=rr,cc
    for s in (strs[0], strs[-1]):
        extend(s,d); extend(s,(-d[0],-d[1]))
    return out

    ok=pred==go
    print(n,'match' if ok else 'MISMATCH')
    if not ok:
        diff=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if pred[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
        print(' ndiff',len(diff),diff[:8])
